g.text: CAD NOTE: Feedback path of FB_B3 (VDD_LPDDR4) must be close to PMIC - 2 (U50)

text.tspan: Follow Kelvin connection for current sensing
The recommendation is to connect the output from logic gate or discrete buffer (with fast rise time) as PORz input rather that slow rising open drain

PORz inputs have slew rate requirements specified. When PMIC nRSTOUT is connected to PORz. Adjust the pull-up to minimize the rise time (100-200 ns) when using an open drain output. PORz is fail-safe and 3.3 V tolerant. The PORz input can to 1.8 V or 3.3 V.
